description: SqliteLogStorage::insert_entry_and_advance_tips wraps the entry INSERT, parent edge INSERTs, parent tip DELETEs, and new tip INSERT all in a single SQLite transaction. This is the correct design: either all succeed or none do, preventing the DAG from being in a state where a tip points to a non-existent entry or where an entry is present but not referenced by a tip. The SQLite WAL mode (set in db_pool.rs) ensures concurrent reads are not blocked by this write transaction.
title: DECISION: SqliteLogStorage insert_entry_and_advance_tips as single transaction is correct atomicity design
